attributes.action: Fund and make air conditioning mandatory in all schools and nurseries.
attributes.background:
Recently the UK has seen the warmest June on record with research showing that this is going to continue. This heat impacted school and work attendances.

Schools are required to use heating in winter but children suffer in the summer.

Mandate and fund air conditioning in all schools/nurseries.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023

Introduce a maximum safe temperature for Early Years settings
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774280
